subject: Post-call cost qualification & initial estimate for Edison Health
messages:
From: Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.com>
To: Sam Hart <sam.hart@edisonhealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call cost qualification & initial estimate for Edison Health

Hi Sam — great to meet today. Quick recap and next steps from our discovery: 

Summary of what we heard
- Primary use: clinical triage assistant and front-line note summarization (short prompts + generation + embeddings for search).
- Expected ramp: pilot ~50M prompt tokens / month (peak), production target 150M tokens/mo in 6–9 months.
- Embedding usage: ~750k vectors/mo initially.
- SLA/billing: preference for hosted API to start, but open to Dedicated reserved capacity if committed volumes/discounts line up.

Initial cost framing (very high-level)
- Typical unit target they asked about: goal around $1,200 per 1M prompt tokens (effective after any discounts).
- Pilot budget range you mentioned: $25k–$75k/mo; finance noted $250k Q4 budget cap for pilot.
- Two viable paths: 1) Hosted pay-as-you-go (no commit) — simpler; 2) Dedicated reserved (1–12 month commit) — lower $/1M at scale.

Attached: edison_cost_model_v0.9.xlsx and pricing_calculator_v0.3.csv — basic bands and a calculator you can edit.

Ask / next steps
1) Can you confirm a realistic expected token shape (avg tokens per session, peak concurrency) — helps refine latency/cost assumptions.
2) If finance wants a short internal model, can you share the top-line pilot budget owner and PO timing?
3) I’ll circulate a 2-option estimate (hosted vs reserved) by end of day Wednesday.

If it helps I can run a 15-min walk-through of the spreadsheet with your finance/ops. Calendly link in my signature.

—Maya
Maya Srinivasan
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Maya — thanks for the recap and the quick turnaround. A few clarifications from our side: 

Confirmed numbers
- Pilot: planning for ~50M prompt tokens/month (customer-facing triage flows), avg ~280 tokens/session, expected 180k sessions/mo.
- Production target (Q3 next year): 140–160M prompt tokens/month.
- Embeddings: initially 700–800k vectors/mo; likely to grow with search use cases.

Budget and procurement
- Pilot budget owner: Emily Cross (Head of Data Products). Pilot allocation: up to $75k/mo but needs finance sign-off; suggested PO w/in 3–4 weeks to start pilot early Nov.

Deployment preference
- Prefer hosted API to validate latency and UX quickly; will consider Dedicated if unit economics push under $1,000/1M tokens at scale.

I’ve attached a short forecast (edison_forecast_q4.csv) for your modeling. If you can produce a 2-option estimate with effective $/1M and monthly cost bands, that would be ideal.

Thanks — Sam
Sam Hart
Head of Product, Edison Health
Attachment: edison_forecast_q4.csv (6 KB, csv)

Team — quick internal note on pricing posture based on Sam’s numbers: 

Recommendation (two-path approach)
1) Hosted (no commit) — proposal with tiers: pilot up to 75M tokens/mo at list $1,400/1M; with volume discount applied turns into $1,150/1M at 75–150M band. Good for quick start, zero commit.
2) Dedicated reserved (3-month minimum commit) — example: commit $60k/mo lead to an effective $850/1M (includes baseline KV cache and prefix caching savings). This assumes typical 60% fraction of generation tokens vs total token count and ~15% savings from batching/kv caching.

Things we need from Maya to lock numbers
- Confirm shape (Sam confirmed 280 tokens/session and 180k sessions/mo).
- Which models they expect to run in production (open models we support vs Llama-family; cost differs).
- Whether embedding traffic needs dedicated nodes (could change SKU pricing).

Maya — I’d draft two simple tabs in the spreadsheet: "Hosted estimate (pilot)" and "Dedicated commit (3mo)" with effective $/1M and 3-month cost. I can drop target effective $/1M numbers inline once you push a version.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Director, Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference

Subject: Updated two-option estimate + short walkthrough offer

Sam — thanks again. Attached is a slightly updated model that reflects the numbers you provided and Marcus’s suggested commit structure. Highlights: 

Top-line options (pilot assumptions: 50M tokens/mo)
- Option A — Hosted pay-as-you-go
  - List price baseline: $1,400 / 1M prompt tokens
  - Pilot estimate: 50M tokens = $70,000/mo (before embedding charges and request/response tokens)
  - Effective after small-volume discount (10%): ~$63,000/mo => ~$1,260 / 1M tokens

- Option B — Dedicated reserved (3-mo commit example)
  - Commit: $60,000 / month for 3 months
  - Projected throughput handled: ~70–90M tokens equivalent with optimized batching and KV cache
  - Effective unit: ~$850 / 1M prompt tokens (post-commit discounts & batching gains)

Embedding estimate (separate line): ~700k vectors/mo -> ~$6,500/mo (approx; depends on vector size & index cost).

Files attached: edison_cost_model_v1.2.xlsx (contains Hosted vs Dedicated tabs + sensitivity for 25–200M tokens) and a short PDF summary. I also pasted a short CSV-friendly summary below for quick copy/paste.

Quick asks
1) Can you confirm Emily Cross as the PO contact and whether PO timing aligns with early November?
2) Would you like us to produce a short procurement packet (SOW + SKUs + payment terms) for finance?

If it helps, Marcus or I can run a 15-min walkthrough of the v1.2 model with Emily and finance tomorrow or Friday. 

Best — Maya
Maya Srinivasan
